A commission of the Pan American Health Organization, a regional office of the World Health Organization that oversees the Americas, reached that conclusion in November 2026, with a formal announcement expected Nov. 17 . Canada lost its measles elimination status in 2025 , as did the United Kingdom and other countries in Europe and central Asia in early 2026. These losses of status are no mystery. articles.summary: This article was written by Karen Crouse and published on Sport & State , a new media company founded by Clay Travis that is built around sports, culture, original voices, and live conversation. * * * * * After the Raiders traded Kirk Cousins to Minnesota and announced that Fernando Mendoza , their No. 1 overall pick in this year’s draft, would make his first start at quarterback Sunday against the reigning Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks, Tom Joanides made a proposal on X, directed at his fellow Raiders season-ticket holders: Listen, everyone going to Allegiant Stadium this Sunday. Stay seated when Fernando scores his first touchdown. Will be an epic gesture from fans to player. Pass it along. — Tom Joanides (@TJoanides) November 11, 2026 Joanides, who lives in Southern California with his wife and two sons, accompanied his father to Raiders games as a child when they were based in Los Angeles and has remained loyal to the franchise after its move to Oakland and then Las Vegas.
